title: Apple and Cinnamon Iced Tea
changes_from_base: Strong black tea cut with apple juice and sweetened with a cinnamon syrup; apple slices instead of lemon and mint.
summary: Strong black iced tea mixed half and half with cloudy apple juice and sweetened with a homemade cinnamon syrup, like apple pie in a glass.

ingredients.item: small red apple, thinly sliced, to garnish

steps.title: Cinnamon syrup
steps.text: Simmer the sugar, water and cinnamon sticks in a small pan for 5 minutes, stirring until the sugar dissolves, then leave the sticks in as it cools so the flavour keeps building.

steps.title: Tea
steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove them, then add the cold water and leave to cool.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Pour in the apple juice and add 5-6 tablespoons of strained syrup, then taste and add more if you want it sweeter. Chill for at least an hour.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pour over ice and float a few thin apple slices in each glass.

tips: Add the syrup a tablespoon at a time; apple juices vary a lot in sweetness.
Cloudy apple juice gives a fuller flavour than clear.
Slice the apple at the last moment, or toss the slices in a little lemon juice, to stop them browning.
storage: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Spare cinnamon syrup keeps 2 weeks in a sealed jar in the fridge. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
